title: DO LARGE GPT MODELS DISCOVER MORAL DIMENSIONS IN LANGUAGE REPRESENTATIONS? A TOPOLOGICAL STUDY OF SENTENCE EMBEDDINGS.
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It conducts a topological analysis of sentence embeddings to determine if GPT models develop 'moral dimensions', specifically focusing on a 'fairness metric' derived from social psychology literature.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its findings are focused on the discovery that sentence embeddings in GPT-3.5 can be decomposed into two distinct submanifolds corresponding to 'fair' and 'unfair' moral judgments, suggesting the model develops a moral dimension based on its training data.
